content:
Iris: quick idea 384370 : holiday waffle + ugly sweater mini-lunch Wednesday? short break, bring a waffle topping to share. winners: best sweater + best topping.
Ben: yes please. i'll bring maple syrup and bacon bits (controversial but delicious).
Kara: count me in. remote folks can submit sweater photos and a topping recipe for a virtual vote.
Iris: plan: lunch 12:30-1pm in kitchen B, ugly-sweater runway at 12:45. remote runway via this thread — post a pic and caption.
holiday-bot: Reminder: "Waffle & Sweater Mini-Lunch" scheduled 2026-02-04 12:30 PT. React with :white_check_mark: to RSVP.
ops-bot: Kitchen B reserved 12:20-13:15. Please label shared dishes.
Ben: RSVP'd 44d caption (sweater): "lights that blink faster than my deploys" photo: https://files.redwood.example/sweater-ben.jpg
Kara: RSVP'd 44d posted remote sweater photo: https://files.redwood.example/sweater-kara.jpg caption: "hand-knit chaos"
Iris: posted my sweater: https://files.redwood.example/sweater-iris.jpg caption: "ugly but very warm"

Iris: last reminder: bring holiday cheer and maybe a nap for after lunch 60a
Ben: see you Wednesday 37a
